struct.title: Atomic resolution crystal structure of the PPIase domain of human cyclophilin G in complex with cyclosporin A.

pubmed.rcsb_pubmed_abstract_text: Water molecules doing time: Atomic-resolution crystal structures of the PPIase domain of cyclophilin G, alone and in complex with cyclosporin A, and together with MD simulations and calorimetry, reveal how trapped water molecules influence the thermodynamic profile of a protein-ligand interaction.
